options.description: Options for the Cloudflare edge. The token and account id are read from the environment.

originDomain.description: A domain in your Cloudflare zone, used by nothing else, that the worker reaches Google Cloud apps under. AWS refuses it.

tunnel.description: Reach the origin through a tunnel it opens to Cloudflare, instead of at its address. A VPS always does.
